findings: The porch relocation is source-consistent: Purdue says the rear/kitchen door faces the alley and identifies room 110 as Back Porch. The revised render places the roofed porch beside that door and leaves the Fifth Street entrance without a covered porch.
GIS identity, shape, dimensions, and local registration check out against feature 927. The transform is an approximate project conversion, not survey control.
The exact roof profile, heights, and facade composition remain estimates. The GIS one-level attribute conflicts with the written two-story BEP, so vertical accuracy is only partly supported.
The corrected modular manifest now matches the reopened asset object names and bounds. The root master library refresh remains coordinator-pending and was not inspected or claimed.
limitations: No measured as-built elevation or date-verified current facade photograph was found in the consulted evidence.
Entrance and porch positions/sizes are supported directionally by the BEP but their exact dimensions and wall offsets remain estimates.
The GIS source and project transformation support local shape/registration checks; they do not establish surveyed positional accuracy.
The root master library refresh is coordinator-pending and was not inspected; this score covers the modular asset/export and corrected manifest only.
